entities.name: Query sequence (188 aa)
observations: Strong homology-based identification as inosine triphosphate pyrophosphatase; best reviewed homolog B0XL39 has 72.1% identity and 97.3% query coverage (protein-analysis tool).

Likely EC 3.6.1.66; reference homologs hydrolyze ITP, dITP, and XTP to corresponding monophosphates plus diphosphate. Exact substrate range is inferred from homolog annotations, not experimentally established for this query.
Reference homolog annotations report Mg2+ or Mn2+ as divalent-metal cofactors; this is not direct evidence for the query sequence.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399, retrieved for close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342, retrieved for close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610, retrieved for close reviewed homologs.
